Name: UiARD
Segments:
- UiPath Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD) certification (preferred).
- UiPath Certified Professional Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD) certification.
- UiPath Certified RPA Associate (UiAR) or UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD)

Name: CER
Segments:
- Knowledge and expertise Cisco Emergency Responder (CER) & Cisco Unified Contact Center Express (UCCX).
- Specify, support and maintain the proper CER space to manufacture our medical devices under defined environmental quality controls.
- Fluency in the toolchains and metrics speech work runs on: ESPnet, NeMo, SpeechBrain, or Kaldi, HuggingFace, forced alignment, and WER/CER and the metrics that go beyond them.

Name: BSL2
Segments:
- There may be potential exposure to BSL2 and BSL2+ biohazard materials
- Work in a laboratory setting (BSL1, BSL2, or BSL2+) with potential exposure to hazardous chemicals, biological materials, and controlled environments.
- Must be willing to work with biohazardous agents (up to BSL2).

Name: PAI
Segments:
- The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) and be skilled in instructing intelligence professionals on the collection and exploitation of Publicly Available Information (PAI) using a variety of OSINT tools and techniques.
- Experience supporting a BLA filing, pre-license inspection (PLI/PAI), PPQ campaign, or commercial go-live of a validated MES.
- Operated inference platforms at the scale of Ant Group, Alibaba Cloud / PAI, Tencent, ByteDance, Baidu, Huawei, DaoCloud, Moonshot, DeepSeek, or comparable teams.

Name: TS SCI
Segments:
- TS SCI Eligible with ability to pass CI polygraph
- Clearance Requirements: TS SCI Eligible and ability to pass CI polygraph
- Clearance: Ability to obtain TS-SCI

Name: GDM
Segments:
- Work alongside colleagues across a variety of functional teams to ensure accuracy and completeness of critical data elements within the Fund's Global Data Master (GDM).
- Experience with Linux desktop session technologies, including X11, Wayland, GDM and D-Bus
- The Control Red Team at AISI is stress-testing control monitors (including from GDM and Anthropic) – finding attacks that beat monitors and attempting to design experiments to measure real-world risk.

Name: pubsec
Segments:
- If you are an operationally fierce program manager with government-contracting chops and extraordinary interpersonal skills who wants to be the linchpin to Databricks' pubsec legal function, we want to talk to you.
- PubSec/Federal experience a plus.
- Extensive Experience: 7–10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in B2B enterprise software. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from customer input through shipped, iterated outcomes. Direct experience working with named strategic accounts, not only through customer success proxies. Experience with hyperscalers, MSSPs and/or PubSec is a solid plus.

Name: EHR-integrated
Segments:
- Lead technical aspects of pre-sales and customer discovery conversations, focusing on EHR integrated digital engagement solutions and clinical care pathway optimizations
- Ticket volume is rising, escalations take too long, and supporting provider-facing, EHR-integrated workflows requires deeper technical and domain expertise.
- Ambulatory Quality & EHR Integration: Strong track record interpreting ambulatory quality measures and successfully translating them into EHR-integrated workflows.

Name: PowerMax
Segments:
- Dell PowerMax (formerly VMAX).
- Dell PowerStore, PowerMax, PowerScale
- Executes DR activation/teardown activities, coordinates Dell hardware patching/upgrades, and monitors PowerMax/DLM/Data Domain health and certificates at both Eagan and San Mateo.

Name: CCFA
Segments:
- CrowdStrike Certifications: Direct experience with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform is required. Active CrowdStrike certifications—such as CCFA (Administrator), CCFR (Responder), CCFH (Hunter), CCFP, or specialized cloud/identity certs (CCCS / CCIS)—are highly desired.
- Relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, CEH, Microsoft SC-300/MD-102, Jamf Certified Admin/Expert, CrowdStrike CCFA/CCFR, or equivalent.
- Certifications such as BTL1/BTL2, GCIH, HTB CDSA, CySA+, CrowdStrike certifications (CCFA/CCFR), cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer) or equivalent hands-on blue team certifications.

Name: Azure Security Specialty
Segments:
- Preferred certifications include CISA, CISM, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CCSK, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, or equivalent.
- Advanced professional certifications such as CISSP, CCSK or relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure Security Specialty).
- Security Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC (GSEC, GCIH, etc.), or cloud security certifications (AWS/Azure Security Specialty) are advantageous, demonstrating a strong foundation in security best practices.

Name: Airflow DAG
Segments:
- Building reusable libraries, operators, and common components for Airflow DAG development.
- You're a generalist by default. We don't silo engineers into "frontend only" or "backend only." When a feature needs a Vue component, a Python handler, a Postgres migration, an Airflow DAG, and an ERP integration, you're expected to handle all of it — with AI doing the typing and you doing the thinking.
- Apache Airflow DAG design, scheduling, sensor patterns, dependency management

Name: Python NLP
Segments:
- Demonstrated professional or academic experience using Python NLP packages such as Spacy, Gensim, or NLTK to analyze or process collections of documents
- Strong knowledge of Python, SQL, Python data science libraries (Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn, etc.), and Python NLP libraries (NLTK, SpaCy, etc.)
- Demonstrated professional or academic experience using Python NLP packages such as Spacy, Gensim, or NLTK to analyze or process collections of documents.

Name: SBU
Segments:
- Familiarity with CUI/SBU data handling requirements
- Audience activation (working with SBU’s and 3rd parties to create audiences at scale for activation)
- Retain documentation regarding loss of event logs (e.g. June 5-7th DNS logs were not ingested from SBU and are lost)

Name: EWA
Segments:
- Build, deploy, and operate the production ML systems at the core of our EWA product, with a focus on reliability, performance, and fast, high-quality execution
- EWA is the core, and several new products are underway on top of it.
- Tools & Systems Training: Deliver hands-on training and ongoing support for platforms such as Salesforce, SalesLoft, EWA, 6sense, and UserGems. Champion adoption by serving as a liaison between Revenue Operations and sellers.

Name: WebUI
Segments:
- Experience in HTTP Protocol and its functionality (RESTful API, Cookie, WebUI, ..)
- Work in the WebUI backend to support web application service features.
- Experience with AI tools and Platforms such as Databricks Data/AI Platform, Open WebUI, n8n, Pinecone, LangChain, LangGraph

Name: Bloomreach
Segment: In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

Name: Data 360
Segment: In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

Name: Spark
Segment: This includes developing reliable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines using technologies such as Spark and Delta Lake, and building ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for both structured and unstructured data.

Name: R
Segment: R
